author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Data Export is a paid DNSFilter add-on. Point its Amazon S3 destination at a bucket a Sophos NG-SIEM S3 Ingest (customer-managed) integration reads; DNSFilter writes CSV files of up to 10,000 queries, one per line, with no header row, in the column order of its log data descriptions page. Queries flagged as threats go to the third-party alert schema (blocked or allowed); all other queries go to DNS, which has no field for the policy decision or categories. The HTTP Event Collector destination sends the same data in a different shape that DNSFilter doesn't document, so it isn't covered. Samples follow the column order and the example exports DNSFilter publishes, with made-up values. Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (61 of 61 fields matched the emulator), and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there; the parent and children have not run together as separate parsers yet. No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
